messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: smart-routing anomaly detected for tenant tenant-acme (high error rate + spillover to Dedicated pool). Auto-mitigation triggered: fallback-policy v2 engaged. Investigate ASAP.
jen: acked. I'm oncall, starting triage. severity?
sam: I see elevated 502s in the hosted endpoints and a sudden jump of requests routed to dedicated-pool-02. Errors align with 03:10 UTC. Full alert: https://redwood.internal/alerts/9832
leila: Support is getting customer tickets: "generation failing intermittently, sometimes returns 500, sometimes long tails". Tenant-acme is on a reserved Dedicated plan; they should never spill into hosted.
miguel: pulling routing logs now. suspect policy mismatch between policy-engine and the compile-cache. Running quick grep: `grep tenant-acme /var/log/routing/*.log | tail -n 200` shows repeated policy-eval results: `route -> fallback(hosted->dedicated) reason=capacity_tier:hostd` (typo).
olga: FYI customer reported 30% failed requests, some downgraded model variants (gpt-open-3-small) unexpectedly. They expect gpt-redwood-3-medium.
ash: (ops note) noticed a config push 03:08 from ci/cd: `policy-engine: deploy v2026-03-15-0307`
jen: interesting, typo in policy (hostd) could cause a fallback rule to match incorrectly. miguel can you paste the policy snippet?
miguel: here's the compiled rule causing the misroute:
```yaml
- id: fallback-tier-rule-12
  match:
    capacity_tier: hostd 
  action:
    fallback_to: dedicated-v2
    allowed_models: [gpt-redwood-3-medium, gpt-redwood-3-small]
```
jen: that `hostd` is the issue — it shouldn't match hosted tenants. The compiler treats unknown keys as wildcard in this release.
sam: immediate mitigations: (1) disable fallback-policy v2, (2) roll back policy-engine to previous deploy, (3) pin tenant-acme to dedicated pool via manual claim. Which do we do first?
leila: I'd disable fallback-policy first to stop further spillover. Support will notify tenant-acme about mitigation.
miguel: done — issuing disable: `POST /admin/policies/v2/disable` -> 202 accepted. Logs show reject responses dropping.
incident-bot: Action logged: policy v2 disabled by miguel at 1794522355.
ash: starting rollback of policy-engine to v2026-03-14-2201 (safe). ETA ~3m.
ash: rollback succeeded at 1794522440. Policy-engine service health OK.
ash: but we still see some stuck sessions in dedicated-pool-02 with KV cache pinned to wrong model-variant.
ash: command to evict sessions: `curl -X POST https://infra.internal/pool/dedicated-pool-02/evict -d '{"tenant":"tenant-acme"}'`
miguel: executed eviction, responses draining.
olga: customers reporting improved success rates to ~95% now. Support sent patch note: "We applied an emergency routing change — you may see minor restarts."
ash: follow-up: need a hotfix to compiler to error on unknown keys instead of wildcard match. Opening PR now.
miguel: also found a secondary problem: fallback policy allowed model variant substitution when running in dedicated. That allowed gpt-redwood-3-small to be picked — causing quality regressions. We should restrict model substitutions for dedicated tenants.
jen: action items while we keep pager open:
- sam: lead postmortem and severity=high.
- miguel: PR for compiler strict mode + tests.
- ash: add a validation rule that dedicated tenants cannot be routed to hosted pools; block misbinds.
- olga: coordinate customer comms and SLA credit calc with billing.
- leila: collect customer tickets and timeline.
sam: will set up a blameless postmortem doc. Also request logs for a 48h window: `s3://redwood-logs/routing/1794*/tenant-acme/*`
miguel: note: we should also add a guard in smart-router to reject rules with key typos that look like capacity_tier (fuzzy-match). I'll include a quick patch in the PR.
jen: handoff: I'm going offline in 16m. Sam will take over pager. Sam, you have ownership from 1794522360.
sam: taking over. I'll update incident channel and start the RCA timeline.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation successful (policy disabled, rollback, session evict). Monitoring 10m for regressions.
olga: customer impact summary to include in postmortem: 45m of increased errors starting at 1794522000, ~30% request failure peak, model-quality regression for ~1200 requests.
ash: postmortem checklist: include exact deploy ID, diff of policy v2, naive compiler behavior, and proposed rollout plan for compiler strict mode.
leila: support note drafted and sent at 1794522850.
miguel: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/policy-engine/pull/482 (hotfix + tests).
sam: I'll schedule follow-up war room 1.5h from now to confirm closure and coordinate SLA with revenue ops.
jen: thanks team. leaving channel. :wave:
sam: closing actions assigned, leaving open until postmortem completed. :thumbsup:
